text:
Jamal (People Ops): Quick: open enrollment closes next Friday. If you got married this month and want to add your spouse, timeline question — can you still do a life event outside OE or does marriage need to wait?
Elena P: congrats on the marriage! You have a 30-day window after the marriage date to add spouse as a life event. so you don't need to wait for OE.
Marcus L: do we need a marriage certificate scan or is an online copy ok? spouse doesn't have SSN yet (international spouse).
Jamal (People Ops): good Q re SSN. you can add spouse without SSN and update later. we do need proof of marriage (signed certificate or official online portal PDF is fine).
Elena P: for international spouses, the carrier may ask for translation or apostille depending on country. upload what you have and we'll escalate.
benefits-bot: Auto-reply: Life event upload steps: 1) Go to https://redwoodbenefits.example.com -> Life events 2) Select 'Marriage' 3) Upload proof (PDF/JPG) 4) Select coverage for spouse 5) Submit within 30 days. See full guide: https://redwoodbenefits.example.com/help/life-events/marriage
Marcus L: what about adding spouse to dental only? I want to keep my medical on spouse's plan. Is dual enrollment allowed?
Elena P: you can enroll dependents on any combination of plans. if spouse's employer covers medical and you choose to stay on theirs, you can still add them to Redwood dental/vision. just choose the tier 'spouse only' for that product.
Marcus L: payroll implications? monthly premium change or catch-up?
Payroll-bot: Notice: Premium changes from life events will be scheduled to take effect based on carrier rules. Payroll will adjust deductions starting the next pay period after benefits confirms enrollment. Retro adjustments may be applied across up to 2 pay periods.
Jamal (People Ops): To minimize retro payroll hits, submit the life event ASAP and select the requested effective date. If you need a manual retro calc for tax reasons, ping payroll@redwood.example and cc benefits.
Marcus L: thanks. I'll upload the scanned marriage certificate tonight. If I can't get an apostille right away, should I add a note in the portal?
Elena P: yes — add a note like "apostille pending" and attach what you have. we'll mark it provisional and follow up.
Jamal (People Ops): one last heads-up: if you miss the 30-day window you'll have to wait until OE unless there's a qualifying exception. We'll monitor submissions and send reminders at 10/5 days remaining.
Marcus L: appreciate it, thanks team :raised_hands:
Jamal (People Ops): np — ping me or @benefits if anything stalls.
